name: whatran
description: Turn a finished analysis into a reproducible, shareable, self-showcasing GitHub repo.

interface.shortDescription: Make an analysis reproducible, shareable, and self-showcasing.
interface.longDescription: Whatran captures a finished analysis as a multi-step pipeline whose declared outputs regenerate from raw inputs. A fresh CI clone verifies reproduction, and a generated site showcases the steps, scripts, and result visualizations — all shared as a normal GitHub repo.
interface.defaultPrompt: Make this analysis reproducible and shareable as a GitHub repo.
